upstreams.name: Everything Claude Code (ECC)
upstreams.installMethod: Claude Code plugin from the ecc marketplace (user scope)
knownLimitations: Ships 71 agents and 311 skills; orchestra uses 7. The rest stay installed but are not called by orchestra.
ECC registers its own hooks (27 groups in 2.2.3). They run alongside orchestra's guard hook.
The repository was renamed from affaan-m/everything-claude-code; the old URL redirects.

upstreams.name: gstack
knownLimitations: Upstream documents Windows 11; this factory was assembled on Windows 10 and gstack's browser tools were not exercised there.
v1.102.1.0 was available on 2026-11-21 but not installed; update per UPDATE_GUIDE.md.
On Windows without Developer Mode, rerun ./setup after every git pull.
Requires Bun and Node.js on PATH for browser skills.

upstreams.name: superpowers
upstreams.installMethod: Claude Code plugin from claude-plugins-official (user scope)
knownLimitations: Its session-start hook tells the model to invoke a skill whenever one might apply; orchestra calls its skills by name and does not rely on that.
Its brainstorming skill is not used inside orchestra workflows.

upstreams.name: graphify
upstreams.installMethod: pip install graphifyy, then graphify install --platform claude
knownLimitations: Building a graph costs tokens; use only for large or unfamiliar codebases.

excluded.name: ECC continuous-learning / instincts
excluded.reason: Writes lessons automatically; orchestra promotes lessons only after human approval.
